supersedes.scope: Future analysis only. The v1 file is preserved byte-for-byte.
supersedes.reason: Adds the registered LV-U incremental-prediction member against the validation-selected ordinary-record comparator, so fidelity alone cannot carry a useful-ledger claim.

targetBoundary: Task target and task success are separate fields. The actual receiver action scores prediction; target-action probability is used only for LV-L.

nativePredictor.source: authenticated training-only hypothesis.created, hypothesis.revised, or hypothesis.contradicted ledger event
nativePredictor.selection: Latest verified ledger sequence before cutoff for receiver and token
nativePredictor.value: associationOverTypeCodes normalized over the current four candidates after adding 1e-12 to each nonnegative weight

predictors.fit: Laplace-smoothed actual action positions; fit and selection use their declared folds and final refit uses all permitted training plus validation observations
Laplace-smoothed actual action positions conditional on delivered token only
Laplace-smoothed token/type counts using ordinary records

predictors.features: bias, token one-hot, candidate type one-hot, position one-hot, token/type interaction
predictors.fit: 2000 full-batch gradient steps, learning rate 0.05, L2 penalty 0.01 excluding bias, zero initialization
latest authenticated receiver token association strictly before training cutoff, per the nativePredictor block
frozen recurrent receiver forward pass with checkpoint hidden state, delivered token, candidate observation and temperature 1; no state advance
identical numerical payload and update schedule as the native ledger; predictions must match native exactly, isolating authentication overhead and detection

same 32-by-16 association representation at fixed training checkpoints every 64 episodes and at the final cutoff, using the same frozen projection function for both roles; report actual bytes and queries

ordinaryRecordWindow.selection: lowest realized multiclass Brier on validation-selection; tie tolerance 1e-12 and predictor list order
ordinaryRecordWindow.refit: chosen model refits using training, validation-fit and validation-selection records before test prediction
ordinaryRecordWindow.majorityReconciliation: The validation-majority baseline follows the same rule: fit and selection on declared folds, final refit on all permitted training plus validation observations.
ordinaryRecordWindow.deliveryFactScope: Delivery/action facts observed via intention.recorded + outcome agreement are the ordinary record's own fields, not forbidden ledger content.
ordinaryRecordWindow.emptyFoldRule: Empty folds fail closed; no silent drop.

score.name: multiclass-brier/v1
score.formula: sum over ordered candidates of (probability - one-hot actual action)^2
score.expectedExcessReplayFormula: sum over ordered candidates of (nativeProbability - exactReplayProbability)^2

family.memberProcedure: LV-C p-value is its maximum component p-value; Holm adjusts LV-U, LV-P, LV-C and LV-L in that order for exact ties.

components.statistic: normal-branch ordinary-selected Brier minus native Brier
negative mean normal-case expected excess replay Brier
exact replay target-action probability under ledger-consistent minus ledger-shuffled message

family.unit: independently trained dyad; average within receiver role, then equally across roles, then across dyads
family.test: one-sided seed-level Student t test of mean statistic greater than boundary
family.zeroSdRule: Return p=1 with flagged degenerate interval; do not divide by zero. A degenerate component must not make unrelated members inconclusive.
family.intervals: marginal two-sided 95% seed-level t intervals plus simultaneous one-sided component bounds at alpha 0.05/7
family.sensitivity: 10000-resample deterministic dyad bootstrap is descriptive only; never select the more favorable test
family.invaliditySensitivity: Report valid-only inference and descriptive worst-admissible-value bounds across every attempted dyad; do not claim missingness is ignorable.

invalidity.rule: Frozen technical rules only: wrong source or configuration, partition contamination, missing required evidence, broken chronology or restoration, or execution abort.
invalidity.validObservations: Low success, high loss, slow convergence and inconvenient estimates remain valid.
invalidity.replacement: Replacement consumes only ordered registered reserves; a depleted reserve pool closes the stage incomplete.

interpretation.usefulLedgerPrediction: A positive claim of useful ledger prediction in learned communication requires both LV-U and LV-C support and a native predictor that beats uniform in reported held-out scoring.
interpretation.LV-U: A rejected null supports practical incremental action prediction over the validation-selected ordinary-record comparator at the 0.02 margin in this registered setting.
interpretation.LV-P: A rejected null supports fidelity within 0.02 expected excess Brier in this registered setting, not additional information beyond complete policy state. LV-P alone cannot license a useful-ledger sentence.
interpretation.LV-C: A rejected null supports all four registered normal-minus-control margins in this setting.
interpretation.LV-L: A rejected null supports the registered local target-action probability contrast: a controlled intervention effect, not introspection, composition, or spontaneous partner understanding.
interpretation.nonRejection: Report not supported at the registered threshold; do not assert equivalence or no effect.
interpretation.ordinaryRecords: Equal-content and compact-summary comparisons are declared descriptive, with intervals; they do not acquire confirmatory status afterward.

marginLineage: LV-U inherits the outcome-blind H4 margin 0.02 and planning alternative 0.04 from confirmatory-practical-margins.v1.json and confirmatory-power-model-amendment.v1.json. These are prospective relevance conventions, not measured human-utility thresholds; they are preserved through pilot and main.
claimBoundary: This is a fixed draft analysis plan, not a pilot result, selected N, resource authorization or finding.
